blocks.content:
If you want to verify from your side, the updater writes to `console-output.log` in the app's logs folder — after clicking Check for Updates you should see `[Menu] Check for Updates clicked`, then either `No update available` (check ran fine, toast just went to the wrong place) or an error line.

Separately from the window-targeting bug, I'd also recommend one behavioral improvement regardless: `setChannel()` today only re-points the feed URL — no check fires until the hourly timer, so switching channels feels inert for up to an hour. Triggering an immediate check on channel switch would fix that impression.
